generationPrompt.prompt: Create Green prop, a prop used for a readable ranch encounter. A rounded prop with a clear silhouette Silhouette: a compact readable outline. Primary volumes: one rounded body. Part relationships: eyes remain attached to the front of the body. Surface features: preserve intentional recesses and protrusions. Bevel only: bevel only silhouette-defining hard edges. Use cute stylized 3D style with compact and broad proportions. Colors: matte black. Materials: matte plastic. Texture: matte stylized surface with readable color separation; maps base color; material {'baseColor': '#111111', 'metallic': 0.15, 'roughness': 0.65}. Keep the mesh at or below 2500 triangles and export fbx. Normals explicit_hard; faces outward; smoothing split normals across silhouette-defining hard edges. Topology integrity: no degenerate or duplicate faces, no coplanar overlaps, and preserve hard-edge vertex/normal splits through triangulation and export. Use scale 1.0, pivot ground center (ground_center); preserve that origin after export, and use collider plan single capsule. Preserve: round silhouette. Exclude: text, weapons.
